about: Saturated cases: with the plugin they averaged 0.93 or more over every recorded run (2026-11-05/06, 4 to 16 runs each), and without it 0.40 or less. They prove the skill once; after that they run with the plugin only, when their own skill's text changes (eval-plan.mjs), and in the monthly --all run. A server or agent change does not trigger them: they test the skill's text. A case leaves this list when a change makes it informative again.
